package ignoredanswer

import (
	"net/http"

	"example.test/auth"
	"example.test/httperr"
)

type Handlers struct{}

func (h Handlers) GetAfterADroppedAnswer(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	auth.IndividualPerformanceOf(r.Context())
	httperr.WriteJSON(w, http.StatusOK, []int{1})
}

func (h Handlers) GetAfterABlankAnswer(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	_, _ = auth.IndividualPerformanceOf(r.Context())
	httperr.WriteJSON(w, http.StatusOK, []int{1})
}

func (h Handlers) GetAfterAnUnreadAnswer(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	allowed, _ := auth.IndividualPerformanceOf(r.Context())
	httperr.WriteJSON(w, http.StatusOK, []bool{allowed})
}

// An error that carries the check checks nothing when it is dropped.
func (h Handlers) GetAfterADroppedRefusal(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	auth.Require(r.Context())
	httperr.WriteJSON(w, http.StatusOK, []int{1})
}

// The way past a refusal that only a bound switch reaches holds no answer
// when nothing bound it.
func (h Handlers) GetUnlessBoundOff(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	if allowed, bound := auth.IndividualPerformanceOf(r.Context()); bound && !allowed {
		httperr.Write(w, r, auth.OffError{})
		return
	}
	httperr.WriteJSON(w, http.StatusOK, []int{1})
}
